dedupe_keys.name: cofactor drammen public building hourly energy and weather

description: SINTEF Community publishes COFACTOR, hourly energy and weather observations for 45 public buildings in Drammen, Norway. Coverage comprises sixteen schools, twenty kindergartens, seven nursing homes and two offices. Series begin in January 2018 and end in December 2021 or March 2022, depending on the measurement. Building descriptors include floor area, construction year, energy label and heating or ventilation characteristics. The current Zenodo archive is publicly downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0. These observations can calibrate building-energy and retrofit simulations in model-energyplus. A caveat is that submeter coverage differs between buildings; an absent submeter must not be interpreted as zero use. One municipality and public-building operator provide limited evidence for other ownership or climate settings. Only repository metadata and the archive manifest were inspected.
